section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch2 — Piaget's 4 Stages (Complete Sequence)
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Arrange Piaget's four stages of cognitive development in the correct chronological order, from birth onward:

options.option_text: Sensorimotor → Pre-operational → Concrete Operational → Formal Operational
Pre-operational → Sensorimotor → Formal Operational → Concrete Operational
Formal Operational → Concrete Operational → Pre-operational → Sensorimotor
Concrete Operational → Formal Operational → Sensorimotor → Pre-operational

explanation: Piaget's four stages, in order: Sensorimotor (0-2), Pre-operational (2-7), Concrete Operational (7-11), Formal Operational (11+).

section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch2 — Piaget's 4 Stages (Complete Sequence)
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A 9-year-old child who can conserve quantity and classify objects logically, but still cannot reason about a purely hypothetical scenario with no concrete referent, is in which Piagetian stage?
explanation: A 9-year-old with conservation and classification ability, but not yet abstract hypothetical reasoning, fits the Concrete Operational stage.
